## ERROR-HANDLER WORKFLOW
Small, standalone workflow. Import it, activate it, then copy ITS workflow id (n8n shows this in the URL bar / workflow settings once saved) and paste that id into master.json's `settings.errorWorkflow` (currently PLACEHOLDER_ERROR_HANDLER_WORKFLOW_ID) -- or set it via the Cloud Production workflow's Settings panel, 'Error Workflow' dropdown, which does the same thing without hand-editing JSON.

n8n calls this workflow automatically whenever ANY node in a workflow that points at it (via settings.errorWorkflow) fails and isn't caught by that node's own onError -- so it's the safety net underneath master.json's local failure branch (Shape Error Payload -> Notify Team of Failure -> Stop with Clear Error), catching anything that branch doesn't (e.g. a node crashing before it reaches an onError-wired node, or a failure in a part of the workflow that has no local error wiring at all).

Wire the Slack credential + channel id below before relying on this.

nodes.name: Format Failure Notification
nodes.notes: n8n's errorTrigger payload shape: execution.id, execution.url, execution.error.message, execution.lastNodeExecuted, workflow.id, workflow.name -- reads those defensively (?.) since the exact nesting has shifted slightly across n8n versions.

nodes.name: Notify Team (Slack, disabled)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default so it cannot fire unwired. Enable once PLACEHOLDER_SLACK_CRED and the channel id are wired -- same credential this repo's master.json 'Notify Team of Failure' node expects, so wiring one wires both.
